title: Garlic Stir Fry with Italian Crunch
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry recipe combining earthy vegetables with crunchy Italian flair.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add broccoli, bell peppers, and onion. Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp.
In a small bowl, mix Italian breadcrumbs and soy sauce. Sprinkle over vegetables.
Stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes, until breadcrumbs are lightly toasted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional Italian breadcrumbs if desired.
